src: I almost forgot.
He gave me $1,000.

text: 걔 생각엔 내가 너를 죽이는 거였어.
src: I think his idea was that I kill you.
But you know, the pity is, when I'm paid...
...I always follow my job through.
You know that.
No Angel Eyes
Yeah, you're right.
It's getting tougher.
The way I figure...
...there's really not too much future with a sawed-off runt like you.
What do you mean?

text: 넌 절대 3000달러 이상의 값어치가 못 될 거 같거든.
src: 'Cause I don't think you'll ever be worth more than $3,000.
What do you mean?
I mean, our partnership is untied.
Oh no, not you.
You remain tied.

text: 돈은 내가 가지고, 넌 로프나 가져.
src: I'll keep the money, and you can have the rope.

text: 이 더러운 배신자! 이 지저분한 망할 짓을...
src: You filthy, double-crossing bastard! Of all the stinking, dirty tricks--
The way back to town is only 70 miles.

text: 숨을 고르면, 너 같은 놈도 해낼 수 있을 거야.
src: If you save your breath, I feel a man like you could manage it.

text: 아디오스. 이 더러운 놈! 여기 와!
src: Adios. You filthy bastard! Come here!

text: 여기 와! 이 줄 풀어줘! 말에서 내려!
src: Come here! Cut this rope off! Get off that horse!
Get off that horse! You filthy coward!
If I ever catch you...
...I'll rip your heart out and eat it!

text: 너를 생가죽째 벗겨버리고, 혀로 목을 메달겠어.
src: I'll skin you alive! I'll hang you up by your tongue.
I'll kill you! I'll kill you!

text: 이 배은망덕한 놈. 내가 너 목숨 몇 번을 살려줬는데.
src: Such ingratitude, after all the times I've saved your life.

text: 날 여기 두고 가면 안 돼...
src: You wouldn't leave me here...
Come back! Wait! Listen, Blondie!

text: 이 큰 년의 아들 같은 놈!
src: Hijo de una gran puta!
